title: CODATA 2022: the proton mass is 1.672 621 925 95 × 10⁻²⁷ kg
summary: In unified atomic mass units the listing gives 1.007 276 466 5789 u. The energy equivalent is 938.272 089 43 MeV.
body: The NIST 2022 listing prints 'proton mass 1.672 621 925 95 e-27' kg, standard uncertainty '0.000 000 000 52 e-27' kg. 'proton mass in u 1.007 276 466 5789', standard uncertainty '0.000 000 000 0083' u. 'proton mass energy equivalent in MeV 938.272 089 43', standard uncertainty '0.000 000 29' MeV.

sources.title: Fundamental Physical Constants, complete listing, 2022 CODATA adjustment
sources.author: NIST, CODATA 2022 recommended values
sources.note: Complete listing of the 2022 CODATA adjustment, opened 2026-11-18. Digits are copied from lines that were printed in full, without an ellipsis.
